lines.zh: 我游过的地方，沙会冒蓝火。
lines.en: Blue flame rises from the sand I pass.

lines.zh: 我身上带着灵魂沙的气味。
lines.en: I carry the smell of soul sand.
The deeper I go, the colder I get. I don't mind.
I keep to the seabed and move slowly.
Blue light follows me like a shadow.
I pass through a group of my own kind.
I'm rare. I know it.
I beat my tail slowly, as if brooding.
The souls in the sand wake under my tread.
I go around that patch of blue fire.

lines.zh: 我的颜色，在深水里看不清。
lines.en: In deep water my colors can't be made out.

lines.zh: 我游到礁石背阴的一面。
lines.en: I swim to the shaded side of the reef.
There's a sound in the water that isn't fish.
I slip into a deep trench.
The deeper I go, the bluer the light.

lines.zh: 我拖着灵魂沙的尾巴游。
lines.en: I swim trailing a tail of soul sand.
I hang still inside a ring of blue.
The souls in the sand whisper.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，吐出的气泡是蓝的。
lines.en: I open my mouth and the bubbles come out blue.
I keep still. Moving makes me glow.

lines.zh: 有条鱼游过来，又拐走了。
lines.en: A fish comes near, then turns away.
I hear the wind of the sea floor.
Someone sank down here once.
I smell old bone.

lines.zh: 蓝火在我背上一跳一跳。
lines.en: Blue flame flickers along my back.

lines.zh: 我像是睡着了，其实没有。
lines.en: I look asleep. I'm not.
The sand is moving and it isn't me.
I'm listening to somewhere deeper.
My shadow falls in the blue flame.

lines.zh: 这片海，我记得比现在冷。
lines.en: I remember this sea being colder.

lines.zh: 你呼吸的热，穿过水面找我。
lines.en: The heat of your breath reaches me through the water.
I'm at your feet and you didn't see me.

lines.zh: 你踩的那块沙，是别人的。
lines.en: The sand you're standing on belonged to someone.
My blue light is on your face.
Coming down? It's cold here.
I don't chase people. I wait.

lines.zh: 你看着我的时候，风停了。
lines.en: The wind stopped while you looked at me.
This face of mine looks a little like yours.
Don't reach in. The water will turn cold.

lines.zh: 你若要下水，先问问灵魂沙。
lines.en: If you mean to enter the water, ask my soul sand first.
The light on me dimmed for a moment.

lines.zh: 我翻过来，蓝的那面朝下。
lines.en: I turn over, blue side down.
Pain, like cold striking through bone.
I sink into the trench, fast.
The souls in the sand have been startled.

lines.zh: 我身上有一个口子，不流血。
lines.en: There's a gash on me, and it doesn't bleed.

lines.zh: 我听见很响的一声，然后没了。
lines.en: I heard a loud sound, then nothing.
Sand spills out of my gills.
Don't come closer. The water will go right through cold.

lines.zh: 你的脚印在岸边，我看见了。
lines.en: I see your footprints on the shore.
I caught what you dropped.
There's soul in this smell.
I swim up, halfway to the surface.
Drop one more and I'll come up.

lines.zh: 这东西在你手里是热的。
lines.en: This thing is warm in your hand.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，蓝光从嘴里出来。
lines.en: I open my mouth and blue light spills out.
Don't throw it far. I swim slowly.
I caught the scent. It's faint.

lines.zh: 你给我，我就告诉你一件事。
lines.en: Give it to me and I'll tell you something.
Once I eat, I'll remember.
You bump me and your hand goes cold.
I draw back and blue fire rises from the sand.
The water got colder from that.
We brush past and you say nothing.
My fin touches your calf.

lines.zh: 我侧身让路，蓝光晃了晃。
lines.en: I turn aside and the blue light wavers.

lines.zh: 你踩在灵魂沙上，怪不得。
lines.en: You're standing on soul sand. That explains it.
After the bump I sink again.
The ground here was never solid.
Don't follow. It's deeper below.

lines.zh: 同类的蓝光，很远就能看见。
lines.en: A kinsman's blue light shows from far off.

lines.zh: 我们隔着一段水，谁也没靠近。
lines.en: We keep a stretch of water between us.

lines.zh: 它们的沙里，埋着很多东西。
lines.en: There's a lot buried in their sand.

lines.zh: 我们不常聚，聚了也不说话。
lines.en: We rarely gather, and when we do we don't speak.

lines.zh: 我跟着一道蓝光游了很久。
lines.en: I followed a blue light for a long time.
It sank into the trench. I didn't follow.
The sea is too big and our kind too few.

lines.zh: 我见过它们聚成一片蓝。
lines.en: I've seen them gather into a field of blue.
That night the sea floor glowed till dawn.
Afterward they all sank away.
I take it in and blue light wraps around it.
This sinks faster than stone.
I swallow and my throat goes cold.
I carry it in my jaws back to the trench.
It's still moving in my mouth.
This much leaves me empty.
I press it under the sand and hide it.
The blue flame scorched one side black.

lines.zh: 吞下去以后，我记起一点。
lines.en: After swallowing, I remember a little.
Some things shouldn't be eaten.
You carry something very bright.
I see it, that bit of fire.
I look up at you from below.
You're the only thing in this water.
I rise slowly.
You haven't noticed.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进暖水，归我了。
lines.en: Your shadow falls into the warm water—mine now.
The blue from the bottom comes up with me.
At this depth I can reach.
One more step and it's done.

lines.zh: 你在岸上走，我在水底跟。
lines.en: You walk on shore; I follow along the bottom.

lines.zh: 浅滩的蓝光里，我等着你。
lines.en: In the blue glow of the shallows, I wait for you.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，沙就冷一点。
lines.en: Every step you take, the sand gets colder.
Blue fire spreads across the surface.
I'll wait for you to come down yourself.
The water is going cold.
You shrug and pull your shoulders in. You felt it.
I fan my tail slowly and rise.
There's blue light at your feet already.
Now you can't back out.
One touch from me and you go cold.

lines.zh: 蓝火顺着我的鳍烧上去。
lines.en: Blue fire runs up along my fin.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，水里全是蓝。
lines.en: I hit you and the water turns blue.

lines.zh: 我掉的是灵魂沙，不是鳞。
lines.en: What I drop is soul sand, not scales.

lines.zh: 这一下，带走了你一点热。
lines.en: That took a little of your warmth.

lines.zh: 你打中我，我散成一片蓝雾。
lines.en: You hit me and I burst into blue mist.
There are voices in the water now.
They aren't coming from me.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫起一圈蓝火。
lines.en: My tail stirs a ring of blue fire.
I sink back and the blue light dies.
I swim out of the soul sand.

lines.zh: 这片水底，埋着很多旧事。
lines.en: A lot of old things are buried on this floor.
Blue fire kindles along my body.
The water's colder than elsewhere. Good.
First I sink to the very bottom.
The light above is far from me.
I rest on the sand a while.
A kinsman in the distance, blue going white.
I didn't go to it.

lines.zh: 这条鱼，不该出现在这里。
lines.en: This fish shouldn't be here.

lines.zh: 火落在水上，我身上的蓝更亮了。
lines.en: Fire falls on the water and the blue on me brightens.

lines.zh: 我从水里被甩到岸上，摔得发闷。
lines.en: I'm flung from water onto land and hit hard.

lines.zh: 水太浅了，我的鳃被压得发疼。
lines.en: The water's too shallow; my gills ache.

lines.zh: 炸响把我推过整片海沟。
lines.en: A blast hurls me across the whole trench.

lines.zh: 箭穿进水里，停在我身上。
lines.en: An arrow comes through the water and stops in me.

lines.zh: 一道白光把我的蓝压下去了。
lines.en: A white light presses my blue down.

lines.zh: 海底空了很久，我瘦得发亮。
lines.en: The floor's been empty a long time; I'm thin and glowing.

lines.zh: 雷打进水，蓝火一下烧遍了我。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and blue fire runs all over me.
No sand here, and no souls.
